turns.content: yaar ajeeb sa scene ho gaya hai. Manav — mera school ka dost, chhe saal se saath reh rahe hain — woh shift ho raha hai, apni fiancée ke saath rahega. Baat theek hai, hona hi tha shaadi se pehle. Par mujhe yeh building ke WhatsApp group se pata chala. Owner ne pucha "flat mein naya banda kab aa raha hai?" Main wahin baitha tha. Mujhe usne bataya hi nahi tha ab tak.

Yaar, woh "wahin baitha tha" wala part hi sabse zyada chubhta hai, na? Logically toh sab samajh aata hai — shaadi hai, life badal rahi hai, saath rehna toh waise bhi nahi hota. But chaar logon ke beech baith ke WhatsApp group se pata chalna ki tumhara 6 saal ka roommate ab yahan nahi rahega — woh ek alag level ka chot lagta hai.

Aur asli baat yeh hai ki move karna galat nahi hai, galat hai uska tarkeeka. Itne saal saath raha ho, toh insaan ko personally batana chahiye — "yaar, main soch raha tha, aisa hai, aisa hoga" — even if woh awkward conversation ho. Usne woh effort nahi liya, aur shayad isiliye itna bura lag raha hai.

Ek cheez aur — ho sakta hai usne soch rakkha ho ki "achha hoga, bata dunga pakka" aur woh conversation hota hi nahi. Ya woh khud confused ho ki kaise bole. But yeh uski explanation hai, tumhara dard abhi real hai.

Kya tum usse baat karne ka soch rahe ho? Ya abhi sirf vent karna hai?

phir raat ko usne casually bola "haan yaar batane hi wala tha, busy chal raha tha." Busy? Chhe saal ek kamre mein rahe hain, uski har cheez mujhe sabse pehle pata hoti thi. Uska rishta pakka hua toh main mithai leke uske ghar gaya tha. Aur ab main building group se pata karta hoon ki mera ghar khali ho raha hai.

Yaar, yeh "busy tha" wali line toh hamesha aati hai, hai na? Aur yeh koi accidental miss nahi hai — koi 6 saal ka roomie, jiski har chhoti cheez tumhe pehle pata hoti thi, woh deliberately nahi batata. Busy toh sab hain, par kuch cheezein pehle hoti hain.

Aur woh mithai wali baat — woh detail hi sab keh deti hai. Tum uske liye woh insaan the jo sabse pehle khush hote. Isliye toh itna bura lag raha hai. Expectations wahi hoti hain jo rishta banata hai, aur tumne toh pyaar se banaaye the.

Ab tumhare paas do raaste hain, aur dono valid hain. Ek — directly bol sakte ho: "yaar, batane mein der ho gayi, par mil ke baat karta toh achha lagta. Isse mujhe acha nahi laga." Yeh confrontation nahi hai, yeh apni feeling share karna hai. Dusra — agar abhi energy nahi hai, toh chup raho. Thoda waqt do, woh khud shayad feel kare ki kuch adhura hai.

Par ek baat — yeh pattern dekh lo. Agar woh aaj aisa hai, toh shaadi ke baad aur door hoga. Kya tum yeh relationship aise hi chale jaane dena chahte ho, ya iska matlab tumhare liye kuch alag hai?

It's fine. I have made my peace with it. People get married, people move on, priorities change. This is how life works. I will figure out the flat situation. It is not a big deal and I would prefer not to make it one.

Hmm.

Mujhe lagta hai tum yahan thoda jaldi peace bana rahe ho. Yeh maturity nahi hai — yeh ek tarah ka shutdown hai. "It's not a big deal" keh do, toh maybe dard feel hi nahi hoga.

Par sach yeh hai ki agar sach mein bura nahi lagta, toh itna sab batane ki zaroorat nahi thi. Kuch bura lagta hai toh woh invalid nahi hota, bhai.

Tumhara apna pace hai. Agar abhi nahi bolna, toh mat bolo. Par "not a big deal" wali copy apne aap ko mat do. Yeh big deal nahi hai, theek hai — par yeh zero deal bhi nahi hai.

soch raha hoon usko bas itna reply kar doon — "Congratulations. I will start looking for a new flatmate from next week." Simple, clean, no drama. Usko bhi clear ho jayega aur mujhe bhi baar baar explain nahi karna padega. Theek hai na yeh?

Yaar, ruk.

Yeh reply functional hai, par yeh wahi shutdown hai jo main bol raha tha. "Congratulations" ke saath flatmate dhundhne wali baat mix karna — yeh usko ek clean transactional exit de raha hai. Jaise 6 saal ka rishta ek admin task ho.

Aur honestly? Usko kuch clear nahi hoga isse. Ise toh usko yeh signal jayega ki sab normal hai, tum perfectly fine ho, chalo naye arrangements karte hain. Par tum fine nahi ho.

Abhi kya kar sakte ho — chaar options hain:

**Pehla:** Reply bilkul mat karo abhi. Ek- do din sochne do. Gusse mein ya hurt mein jo bhi bologe, wahi reh jaata hai.

**Doosra:** Sirf itna bolo — "Yaar, mujhe thoda bura laga ki main pehle se nahi jaanta tha." Bas. Koi solution nahi, koi flatmate search nahi, koi drama nahi. Sirf apni feeling.

**Teesra:** Agar sach mein chahte ho ki yeh conversation ho hi nahi, toh theek hai. Par phir yeh accept karo ki yeh ek silent goodbye hai — aur uske saath kaise feel karte ho, woh apne aap se honest raho.

**Chautha:** Usse milein, aankhon dekh ke baat karein. Messages mein sab controlled lagta hai.

Par "Congratulations + flatmate dhundhna" — yeh woh reply hai jo tum apne aap ko force kar rahe ho mature dikhane ke liye. Mature hona alag hai, apne aap ko suppress karna alag.
